title: Positive tensor powers preserve absolute ampleness
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], M an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module], and k a positive natural number. If M is ample [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], then its kth tensor power is ample.

proof.text: Unpack IsAmple, retain compactness, and at a point choose n > 0, a global section s of M.tensorPow n and its affine nonvanishing open U. Form a = tensorPowSection (homOfGlobalSection (M.tensorPow n) s) k. The existing tensorPowMulIso, its inverse, and Nat.mul_comm give e : (M.tensorPow n).tensorPow k ≅ (M.tensorPow k).tensorPow n. Evaluate a followed by e.hom at one to obtain t.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-section-nonvanishing-zero-locus] to identify both nonvanishing loci with complements of zero-locus supports. The proved private helper nonvanishingLocus_app_one identifies homOfGlobalSection of evaluation at one with the original morphism, using unitHomEquiv injectivity and naturality. Apply the existing proved source theorem Hom.zeroLocus_eq_of_arrowIso to remove e, then compl_support_zeroLocus_tensorPowSection (WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.AffineComplement) with hk to identify the two supports. Thus nonvanishingLocus t = nonvanishingLocus s.

Keep the original n, its positivity, and the affine open U. Transport each pointwise equality of membership through the equality of nonvanishing loci just proved. These witnesses and the original compactness prove IsAmple X (M.tensorPow k), including when X is empty.
